name: bld4_fitting_range_inter_ker_pow_card
statement: (K : Type*) [Field K] (ι : Type*) [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] (A : Matrix ι ι K) (v : ι → K) (h : (A ^ Fintype.card ι).mulVec ((A ^ Fintype.card ι).mulVec v) = 0) : (A ^ Fintype.card ι).mulVec v = 0
closed: ∀ (K : Type*) [Field K] (ι : Type*) [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] (A : Matrix ι ι K) (v : ι → K) (h : (A ^ Fintype.card ι).mulVec ((A ^ Fintype.card ι).mulVec v) = 0), (A ^ Fintype.card ι).mulVec v = 0
informal: Uses Mathlib2.bld3_rank_pow_card_stabilizes and Mathlib2.bld2_rank_pow_convex: with N = A^n, stabilisation (base case from rank_pow_card_stabilizes, propagated to exponent 2n by rank_pow_convex) gives rank(N * N) = rank N. By rank–nullity ker N ≤ ker (N * N) have equal finrank, hence are equal, which is the claim (Fitting: range N ∩ ker N = 0).
type: ∀ (K : Type u_1) [inst : Field K] (ι : Type u_2) [inst_1 : Fintype ι] [inst_2 : DecidableEq ι] (A : Matrix ι ι K) (v : ι → K), (A ^ Fintype.card ι).mulVec ((A ^ Fintype.card ι).mulVec v) = 0 → (A ^ Fintype.card ι).mulVec v = 0
